apps/web/src/app/core/home-route.ts, core/playback.ts (the home rung), features/worker/ (the card), app.html (the label)
deviations: Media only, by id (section 5b): no /commands. The phone creates jobs through Firestore, and the agent's wish is already near-instant
Hosted by the machine agent, not the worker or a server, so clips play while no worker is running
Access is approval (users/{uid}.status == APPROVED, cached a minute), not a confirmed email: require_verified_email=False
Away from home the clip's bucket copy (ADR-0018) is still used; Sarungano's 'media only over the home wifi' rule is not adopted
Switched on and off by an admin-only wish on agents/{id} (homeRouteDesired), not a desktop settings file; hostname, address and port come from .env
lego, its account and the certificates live under ~/.clipforge/home, outside the repository
The copied reference files are exempt from the project's pathlib and UP017 lint rules (pyproject.toml), so upgrades stay readable diffs
No self-test button: the Worker page shows the certificate, the token, the firewall rule and whether this device reaches the PC

where: apps/web/src/app/app.ts and app.html (version line, Update ready, Updated to)
deviations: Keeps Angular's service worker (PLAN.md Phase 7's offline shell) and uses app-update.ts for the newest build
The backend restarts through the machine agent's wish and uv sync, skipped (not paused) while a job is running or queued; --restart finishes it later
The release deploys every target (rules, indexes, storage, the PWA, the site) through tools/deploy.ps1
No Cloud Functions: the worker and the agent ingest their own errors into Firestore through the Admin SDK, in a background thread (Sarungano's shape, on Firestore instead of SQLite)
Captured through a structlog processor, because ClipForge's structlog prints straight to stdout; a root logging handler covers third-party libraries, and the excepthooks what escapes
Only the PC's processes (apps worker and agent). The PWA's own errors are not captured: there is no server endpoint for an unauthenticated report
Captured level is error, not warn (Sarungano's owner's choice, adopted); network failures become warnings and so are not captured
Rate-capped at 30 reports a minute per process
No email alerts and no alert settings: a new, reopened or watched group raises a NEW_ERROR push notification to admins (clipforge/notify)
Deleting a group deletes its occurrences from the client first (no recursiveDelete); occurrences carry their own id for that
No retention clean-up of resolved groups yet, and no Logging settings page
No userId, url or userAgent on an occurrence: extra carries the log line's context (job, stage, host, pid)
The blueprint was drawn from this project
Token encrypted with a machine-local key, not DPAPI
No playlists
Default privacy is unlisted, not private
No rights gate (removed at the owner's request, ADR-0020)

The blueprint was drawn from this project
